name_zh: 马哈迪·穆罕默德：从殖民医生到现代化推动者的『科技民族主义』与后殖民治理范式
name_en: Mahathir Mohamad: From Colonial Doctor to Modernization Architect — 'Techno-Nationalism' and Post-Colonial Governance Paradigm
description_zh: 马哈迪·穆罕默德（Tun Dr. Mahathir Mohamad，1925-2024）是马来西亚第四任总理（1981-2003），也是现代马来西亚最重要的政治家和现代化推动者之一。他出身吉打州普通马来人家庭，爱丁堡大学医学学位（1953年），从乡村医生起步，通过人民统一党（PAM）进入政坛。马哈迪的核心思维贡献在于将'科技民族主义（Techno-Nationalism）'从后殖民时代的被动追赶升维为可操作的现代化工程——通过'国家汽车计划→多媒体超级走廊→基础设施先行→伊斯兰现代性重构'四阶段路径，在马来西亚多元种族社会中建立了以科技自立为核心的现代化治理框架。他提出了'亚洲价值观（Asian Values）'理论：强调集体利益优先于个人自由、权威治理优于多元争论、发展优先于人权的渐进式民主化。马哈迪是Protreptic中模式34（战略预判法）在'后殖民国家科技追赶与现代化工程化'场景的唯一东南亚样本，也是模式12（系统思维）在'多元社会现代化治理工程化'场景的独特代表。他的'亚洲价值观'辩论对理解非西方国家的现代化路径选择具有不可替代的研究价值，也为发展中国家的大国崛起提供了经典案例。
description_en: Tun Dr. Mahathir Mohamad (1925-2024) was Malaysia's fourth Prime Minister (1981-2003), one of modern Malaysia's most consequential political figures and modernization architects. Born to a modest Malay family in Kedah, educated at Edinburgh University (1953), he entered politics from his roots as a village doctor through the Malay Nationalist Party. Mahathir's core contribution was engineering 'Techno-Nationalism' from post-colonial catch-up into actionable modernization — across four phases: National Car Programme, Multimedia Super Corridor, infrastructure-first development, and Islamic modernity reconstruction. He formulated the 'Asian Values' thesis: prioritizing collective interests over individual liberty, authoritative governance over pluralist debate, and development before full democratization. Mahathir is the key Southeast Asian sample of mode 34 (Strategic Prediction) in 'post-colonial technological catch-up and modernization engineering,' and the unique representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'multi-ethnic modernization governance.' His Asian Values debate provides irreplaceable insights into non-Western modernization pathways.
reason_zh: 马哈迪填补了Protreptic在'后殖民国家科技追赶工程化'领域的东南亚空白。他以从乡村医生到政治强人的极端跃迁，展示了'科技民族主义'如何在资源约束条件下操作化国家现代化；也是模式34在'亚洲价值观与西方自由主义之争'场景的唯一马来西亚样本。他的国家汽车计划（Proton）、多媒体超级走廊和伊斯兰现代性理论对理解非西方国家的现代化路径具有不可替代的研究价值，也为发展中国家的科技自立提供了经典案例。
reason_en: Mahathir fills Protreptic's Southeast Asian gap in 'post-colonial technological catch-up engineering.' His transition from village doctor to political strongman demonstrates how 'techno-nationalism' operationalizes national modernization under resource constraints; also the sole Malaysian sample of mode 34 in 'Asian Values vs. Western liberalism debate.' His National Car Programme (Proton), Multimedia Super Corridor, and Islamic modernity theory provide irreplaceable insights into non-Western modernization pathways for developing nations.
steps_zh: 第1步（模式34战略预判法）：科技自立蓝图——识别'马来西亚依赖外资和外国技术'的结构性弱点，1983年启动国家汽车计划（Proton），与日本三菱技术合作建立本土汽车工业，以'被剥夺的马来西亚人（Malay withdrawal）'概念动员马来族群对科技主权的政治支持
第2步（模式12系统思维）：多媒体超级走廊（MSC）——1995年启动，打造东南亚硅谷，吸引高科技企业（微软、IBM、SAP）入驻布城；建设马来西亚首条光纤骨干网络，推动电子政务和数字经济基础设施
第3步（模式20价值链重构）：基础设施先行战略——建设双峰塔（Petronas Towers，1998年世界最高建筑）、吉隆坡国际机场、南北大道高速公路网，以'基础设施即战略资产'理念重塑国家空间经济格局
第4步（模式31框架效应法）：亚洲价值观辩论——在1997年亚洲金融危机期间拒绝IMF救助条件，推行资本管制和令吉贬值（1998年），以'亚洲价值观'对抗西方自由主义治理模式，强调'发展权优先于选举民主'
第5步（范式固化）：科技民族主义——将'汽车计划→MSC走廊→基础设施→亚洲价值观'四环沉淀为后殖民国家科技自立的可操作模板
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 34 Strategic Prediction): Technological self-reliance blueprint — identified Malaysia's structural weakness of 'dependence on foreign technology'; launched National Car Programme (Proton) in 1983 with Mitsubishi collaboration; mobilized Malay political support through 'Malay withdrawal' concept for technological sovereignty

Step 2 (Mode 12 Systems Thinking): Multimedia Super Corridor — launched 1995, building Southeast Asia's Silicon Valley attracting tech giants (Microsoft, IBM, SAP) to Putrajaya; constructed Malaysia's first fiber-optic backbone network for e-government and digital economy

Step 3 (Mode 20 Value Chain Reconstruction): Infrastructure-first strategy — Petronas Towers (1998 world's tallest), KL International Airport, North-South Expressway network; reconfiguring national spatial economy through 'infrastructure as strategic asset' philosophy

Step 4 (Mode 31 Framing Effect): Asian Values debate — during 1997 Asian Financial Crisis, rejected IMF conditions, imposed capital controls and ringgit devaluation (1998); positioned 'Asian Values' against Western liberal governance, emphasizing 'development rights before electoral democracy'

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Techno-nationalism — condensing 'car programme → MSC corridor → infrastructure → Asian Values' into an operable template for post-colonial technological self-reliance
expected_zh: 掌握马哈迪从乡村医生到现代化推手的科技民族主义路径
理解'亚洲价值观'理论与西方自由主义的治理争辩逻辑
评估马来西亚科技自立模式对发展中国家的持续启示价值
expected_en: Master Mahathir's techno-nationalist path from village doctor to modernization architect
Understand the governance debate between 'Asian Values' theory and Western liberalism
Evaluate the continuing heuristic value of Malaysia's technological self-reliance model for developing nations
case_zh: 1925年7月10日生于马来西亚吉打州亚罗士打，父亲是乡村教师。爱丁堡大学医学学士（1953年），在吉打和玻璃市担任乡村医生期间目睹马来人的经济边缘化。1963年加入巫统（UMNO），1974年被东姑·拉扎克解除部长职务后，撰写《马来西亚的悲剧》（1970年）痛斥马来人被自己国家经济边缘化。1981年以67岁高龄出任马来西亚第四任总理，执政长达22年。推动建立了国家汽车公司（Proton，1983年）、国家石油公司（Petronas，1974年成立但经他大幅扩张）、多媒体超级走廊（1995年）。建设了双峰塔（1998年，当时世界最高建筑）、吉隆坡国际机场、布城行政中心。1997年亚洲金融危机期间，他拒绝国际货币基金组织（IMF）救助方案，反而通过资本管制和强制令吉贬值成功抵御危机，马来西亚经济复苏速度远超受IMF救助的泰国和印尼。2018年以92岁高龄重新执政（马来西亚最老国家领导人），推动'废除一马公司丑闻相关条约'和改革王室特权。2024年7月逝世，享年98岁，被誉为'马来西亚现代之父'。
case_en: Born July 10, 1925 in Alor Setar, Kedah, Malaysia. Father was a village schoolteacher. Edinburgh University medical degree (1953), served as rural doctor in Kedah and Perlis witnessing Malay economic marginalization. Joined UMNO in 1963, dismissed as minister by Tunku Razak in 1974; wrote 'The Malay Dilemma' (1970) decrying Malay economic marginalization. Became Malaysia's fourth Prime Minister at 67 in 1981, ruling for 22 years. Established Proton (national car company, 1983), significantly expanded Petronas (national oil company, established 1974), launched Multimedia Super Corridor (1995). Built Petronas Towers (world's tallest in 1998), KL International Airport, Putrajaya administrative center. During the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis, rejected IMF conditions and instead imposed capital controls and ringgit devaluation — Malaysia's economic recovery far outpaced Thailand and Indonesia which accepted IMF bailouts. At 92, re-elected PM in 2018 (oldest national leader), investigated 1MDB scandal and reformed royal privileges. Died July 2024 at age 98, called 'the Father of Modern Malaysia.'
